rows.ARS:
Deep pink Floribunda.
Registration name: CANsend
Exhibition name: Colchester Beauty
rows.Origin:
Bred by P. Roger Pawsey (United Kingdom, before 1989).
Introduced in United Kingdom by Cants of Colchester Ltd. in 1989 as 'Colchester Beauty'.
rows.Bloom: Deep pink. Strong fragrance. Medium, semi-double to double, borne mostly solitary, cluster-flowered, in large clusters, cupped-to-flat bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Medium, bushy. Medium, semi-glossy, dark green foliage.

Height: 2' to 32" (60 to 80cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Can be used for beds and borders, container rose or garden. Requires spring freeze protection (see glossary - Spring freeze protection) . Can be grown in the ground or in a container (container requires winter protection).
